goal: Implement deterministic Crash and Restart Recovery on backend startup in telegram_bot.py

contracts.interfaces: execute_recovery_on_startup function signature and recovery diagnostics
function_signatures: execute_recovery_on_startup(sb: Optional[Any] = None, notifier: Optional[Any] = None, binance_map: Optional[Dict[str, float]] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]

execution_steps: Write test in test_restart_recovery.py verifying execute_recovery_on_startup rehydrates state, checks SL/TP breaches on reboot, and sends Telegram recovery alert
Run python test_restart_recovery.py to verify failure (red phase)
Implement execute_recovery_on_startup in telegram_bot.py and invoke it in worker initialization
Run python test_restart_recovery.py to verify green phase
Run lint and typecheck verification commands
acceptance_criteria: execute_recovery_on_startup inspects active bots, sessions, and open trades on container boot
Checks if price movements breached SL/TP during downtime and executes immediate closures
Emits Telegram recovery notification and records recovery metrics in _WORKER_DIAGNOSTICS

rollback.command: git checkout HEAD -- telegram_bot.py; rm -f test_restart_recovery.py contracts/TSK-CLOUD-011.contract.json
